versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.15

- Clarified routing: now directs requests with imported image/video references or locked subjects to `p-video-2-pro-reference`.
- Updated "When NOT to use" table to include and describe the new `p-video-2-pro-reference` skill.
- Adjusted routing and agent guidance to distinguish better between scenarios for simple, quick clips and those requiring subject or style locking.
- Removed redundant skill-card documentation file.

p-video 1.0.14

- Updated SKILL.md to version 1.0.14.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No behavioral or interface changes described; documentation cleanup only.

**Expanded routing and clarified boundaries for p-video.**

- Improved the description and warnings to clarify when to use or route away from `p-video`, especially for cinematic, 1080p, and imported audio needs.
- Updated agent routing: direct cinematic generation with audio to `p-video-2-pro`; 1080p/imported audio/drafts to `p-video-2`.
- Added and adjusted "When NOT to use" section with new options (`p-video-2-pro`, updated `p-video-2`), with sharper role descriptions.
- Removed deprecated documentation file (`skill-card.md`).

**p-video 1.0.12 – distinguishes quick/simple video from best-quality**

- Updated description and routing: Use `p-video` for simple, quick clips (drafts, B-roll, basic motion); use `p-video-2` for highest-quality or tighter lip-sync.
- Added clear guidance to redirect requests for hero shots or best-quality clips to `p-video-2`.
- Clarified scope and boundaries—do not use for talking-head-only, best-quality, or multi-scene tasks.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file for simplification.
- Improved skill selection tables and agent guidance for easier task routing.

p-video 1.0.11

- Updated skill guidance to recommend `p-video-edit` for text-based editing of existing clips (new out-of-skill scenario).
- Clarified boundaries for in-skill vs. out-of-skill: editing, assembly, and model-based edits now explicitly redirect to other skills.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Bumped skill version to 1.0.10.
- Updated SKILL.md metadata to reflect new version.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

- Bumped version to 1.0.9.
- Updated `SKILL.md` to reflect the new version.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.

p-video v1.0.8

- Agent now explicitly opens a `generation-diversity` clarification intake before the first generation request.
- Updated agent guidance to reflect this intake process in "Agent habit" section.
- Removed redundant or outdated file: skill-card.md.
- Version bump to 1.0.8 in metadata.

**Major update: simplifies and clarifies usage, consolidates references, and introduces explicit prerequisites.**

- Adds a **Prerequisites** section with required companion skills and installation commands for prompt craft and API usage.
- Defines a strict **agent reply habit**, requiring first reply checks for API key and proper prompt draft practices.
- Expands **prompt crafting guidelines** for faithful, user-matched, and diverse video prompts, referencing best practices via other skills.
- Moves detailed policies and checklists to external skills; removes in-skill references and older guide files.
- Makes **skill boundaries and redirect logic** explicit, with table of out-of-scope skills and install commands.
- Updates metadata and file structure, reflecting streamlined documentation and remixed example code.

p-video 1.0.6

- Updated skill description for clarity and put greater emphasis on single-clip generation.
- Added a new "Shared generation policy" section outlining mandatory pre-generation steps and quality checks.
- Updated all policy and reference links to new `/references/policies/` paths for improved documentation consistency.
- Removed the obsolete `skill-card.md` file.
- Increased version metadata to 1.0.6 and improved documentation structure.

- Clarified skill boundary: p-video now strictly handles one video clip per invocation; multi-scene or parallel assembly requests are redirected to dedicated skills.
- Added new guidance on agent and data safety handling before uploads or paid actions.
- Updated documentation structure for simpler navigation and clearer execution rules.
- Removed legacy references to parallel execution and multi-scene pipelines from this skill’s documentation.
- Added and referenced the new agent-safety document; removed outdated files.

p-video 1.0.1

- Refined SKILL.md to clarify scope: for single video clips, start/end frame animation, B-roll, and cinematic shots—not multi-scene or avatar videos.
- Updated intake and reference links to point to new plugin/workflow structure and documentation locations.
- Removed pspm.json and skill-card.md for simplification.
- Improved prompts and usage instructions for visual transition and scene chaining, with more accurate external references.
- Added explicit exclusion of talking-head and motion transfer scenarios in description.

p-video 0.0.1

- Initial release of the skill for generating premium video clips from text, images (start/end stills), or optional audio.
- Supports single-clip, start/end frame animation, B-roll, and cinematic shots.
- Enables “first/last frame chaining” for multi-scene handoffs and motion interpolation between two images.
- Outlines key HTTP usage patterns, required/optional parameters, and best practices for continuity.
- Includes usage guides, example curl commands, and references for advanced pipelines and workflows.

- Initial release of the p-video skill for generating premium video from text, stills, or audio.
- Supports animating between start and end images for smoother scene transitions.
- Enables creation of B-roll, cinematic clips, and multi-scene narrated videos with flexible chaining.
- Accepts prompt, duration, resolution, fps, and optional audio or image anchors for detailed control.
- Includes documentation on HTTP usage, best practices for continuity, and multi-scene pipeline integration.
